name: Design Portfolio
summary: Designer portfolio template: an installable Next.js PWA with SSR and a Gmail-powered contact form.
description: A designer portfolio website built as a Progressive Web App with the T3 stack: Next.js 15, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. Installable with offline support, splash screens and standalone display; fully server-rendered with routes for the portfolio home, /experience and /connect. The contact form sends email through the Gmail API. MIT-licensed and ready to deploy to Vercel, Netlify or any HTTPS host.
